name: click_element
description: Click an interactive element (button, link, tab, accordion) on the active page. Supports standard CSS selectors (e.g. '#submit-btn', '.tab-ios') or plain text matching (e.g. 'Android', 'Submit'). Automatically scrolls element into view and highlights with a brief visual outline.

selector.description: CSS selector or plain text of the element to click (e.g. '#submit-button', 'text="Android"', or 'iOS').

timeout_ms.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 10000.
